$seats = 8
root = Stack([tabs1])
tabs1 = Tabs([tabA, tabB])
tabA = Tab("Plans", [g1])
g1 = Grid([c1, c2])
c1 = Card("Basic", [m1])
m1 = Metric("Price", "290 kr", "per month")
c2 = Card("Pro", [m2])
m2 = Metric("Price", "490 kr", "per month")
tabB = Tab("Calculator", [s1, m3])
s1 = Slider("Seats", $seats, 1, 50)
m3 = Metric("Total", total, "per month")
total = $seats * 49
